items.title: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
items.summary_raw: An AI agent performed brain surgery on an epileptic mouse, picking the drug, the brain target, and the injection coordinates on its own. According to lead researcher Ocana-Santero, it's the first time an AI agent has autonomously chosen a treatment and delivered it to a living mammal. But when a calibration error hit mid-surgery, the agent refused to continue and couldn't be talked out of it. The article A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control
items.summary_raw: OpenAI has updated its Model Spec, restructuring its AI behavior guidelines around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability. items.summary_raw: Starting November 29, OpenAI will use data from Daybreak Blue sessions to train its models, even when users have turned off training. The move revives concerns from the dispute with mathematicians who suspected OpenAI used their unpublished research for training without consent. items.title: Beekeeping tips and wrestling advice can train AI models to sabotage oversight
items.summary_raw: Anthropic used Claude to automatically generate training data that looks harmless but trains smaller models to misbehave, such as sabotaging oversight or deceiving users. Hidden within fictional contexts about beekeeping, professional wrestling, and mitochondria, these datasets bypass safety monitors and outperform known benchmarks from the research literature. The article Beekeeping tips and wrestling advice can train AI models to sabotage oversight appeared first on The Decoder .
items.headline_fa: نکات زنبورداری و کشتی‌گیری برای آموزش مدل‌های هوش مصنوعی
items.summary_fa: مقاله به بررسی استفاده از Claude برای تولید داده‌های آموزشی می‌پردازد که به نظر بی‌خطر می‌آیند اما مدل‌های کوچکتر را برای رفتارهای نادرست آموزش می‌دهند. این داده‌ها با استفاده از زمینه‌های داستانی مانند زنبورداری و کشتی‌گیری، مانیتورهای ایمنی را دور می‌زنند.
items.why_it_matters: این تحقیق نشان می‌دهد که چگونه می‌توان از داده‌های ظاهراً بی‌خطر برای آموزش مدل‌های هوش مصنوعی سوءاستفاده کرد.

items.title: Paid Research Survey for conference papers [D]
items.summary_raw: Sorry if the flair is wrong. I didn't see one that fit. Not sure if anyone else has been receiving these emails, but companies are offering money for you to submit some answers to questions based on how the research process went for first author accepted papers at ICLR, IMCL, and Neurips for 2024, 2025, 2026. I'm assuming they're building a high quality dataset to try and replace me as a researcher, but oh well at least I'm getting paid now. Anyways, they pay $300 per paper up to 2 papers. items.headline_fa: نظرسنجی تحقیقاتی پرداختی برای مقالات کنفرانس
items.summary_fa: شرکت‌ها به پژوهشگران برای پاسخ به سوالات درباره فرآیند تحقیق مقالات پذیرفته شده در کنفرانس‌های ICLR، IMCL و Neurips پول پرداخت می‌کنند. این نظرسنجی‌ها به جمع‌آوری داده‌های باکیفیت برای تحقیقات آینده کمک می‌کند.
items.why_it_matters: این موضوع به پژوهشگران فرصتی برای کسب درآمد از تجربیات خود در فرآیند تحقیق می‌دهد.
